audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference to Kayle's ultimate was the placeholder 'Divine Judgment (Invuln)' with no duration, so the biggest spike in the lane had no number attached.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 baiting it buys 160 seconds - more than two full waves - which is the entire reason the dive is correct at 6. Celestial Blessing is 15s and Radiant Blast 12/11/10/9/8s.
audit.corrected: report[9].t, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, whys[4] and spikes[1].text now carry the 160s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the page never names a single Kayle ability, and report[5].t (Key Ability Interactions) was a stub that named no interaction at all.
audit.why: Radiant Blast reduces the resistances of everything it hits from 900 range, so stacking armour is the wrong reflex and she out-ranges Apprehend (535) by 365 units. Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset, so her wind-up is the tell rather than the cast. Celestial Blessing heals her and grants move speed every 15s.
audit.corrected: report[5].t rewritten around Radiant Blast's resistance shred and the ult timer; spikes[0].text now names Radiant Blast and its 12s cooldown.
